Class ArtifactAgeService

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.versions.api.ArtifactAgeService
public class ArtifactAgeService extends Object
Applies the minimumReleaseAge filter: a version newer than the one in use is offered as an update only once it has been published for at least the configured number of days.

The publication date of a version is the modification time of its POM as the Maven Resolver delivers it. The Resolver's HTTP transports stamp a downloaded file with the repository's Last-Modified header, so the lookup goes through the session's transport and picks up its proxy, mirror and serverId authentication settings. A POM that did not come from an HTTP repository, for example one copied into the local repository by mvn install, carries the time it was written and is therefore treated as published then.

Dates are looked up only for versions newer than the current version of the artifact, and are cached for the lifetime of this instance. A version whose date cannot be determined is offered, and a warning says so, so that the filter is never switched off unnoticed.

Since:
2.25.0

    • ArtifactAgeService

      public ArtifactAgeService(org.eclipse.aether.RepositorySystem repositorySystem, org.eclipse.aether.RepositorySystemSession session, org.apache.maven.plugin.logging.Log log, int minimumReleaseAge, Collection<String> excludes)
      Creates a new instance.
      Parameters:
      repositorySystem - the repository system used to fetch the POMs
      session - the repository session, carrying the proxy, mirror and authentication settings
      log - Maven build log
      minimumReleaseAge - the minimum age in days; 0 or less disables the filter
      excludes - groupId:artifactId patterns of artifacts exempt from the filter; may be null. * matches any run of characters; a missing artifactId matches every artifact of the group

    • filterVersionsByAge

      public Stream<org.eclipse.aether.version.Version> filterVersionsByAge(org.apache.maven.artifact.Artifact artifact, Stream<org.eclipse.aether.version.Version> versions, org.eclipse.aether.resolution.VersionRangeResult versionRangeResult)
      Drops the versions that are newer than the current version of the artifact and younger than the minimum age. The current version and older ones pass without a lookup.
      Parameters:
      artifact - the artifact whose versions are being filtered; its version is the current one
      versions - the candidate versions
      versionRangeResult - the range result, which names the repository each version came from
      Returns:
      the versions that remain
